fairness.details: CommitmentSafePredictiveMpc.allocation is recorded in notes/audit but does not alter candidate generation, scenario construction, or argmax. Differing ALNS seeds (seed vs seed+1) change candidates and can fabricate a false proposed-vs-stochastic win.
fairness.algorithmic_difference_if_seeds_matched: none — identical argmax over identical rollouts

first_action_tests.tie_reason: Both predicted values and sticky plant outcomes differ across first actions.

reason: Under matched seeds/budgets, predictive MPC is algorithmically equivalent to stochastic rollout and is worse than B1 more often than it wins on the focus cases. The earlier A_dense_arrivals win does not survive matched seeds.
